name: Ossian Dzelukou-Torgilsson
role: loan shark and bookmaker operating out of Gravesend Basin
location: Gravesend Basin — operates from the back booth of a noodle stall called Mama Nkosi's Overflow
description:
Ossian is a broad-shouldered man going soft around the middle, with dark Ewe-complexioned skin, a close-cropped silver beard, and the patient, unhurried eyes of someone who has learned that time is always on his side. His left hand is a prosthetic — matte-black carbon composite, articulated fingers that tap against tabletops in slow, deliberate rhythms when he's calculating. He dresses in well-maintained but unglamorous clothes: thick-weave trousers, a collared shirt perpetually rolled to the elbows, a canvas jacket with too many interior pockets. He smells faintly of cardamom tea and printer toner.

Ossian does not threaten. He explains. There is a profound difference, he will tell you, between a man who says 'pay me or else' and a man who lays out, with genuine sorrow, exactly what the mathematics of your situation require. He has a gift for making debt feel like a mutual inconvenience rather than a trap, right up until the moment it becomes inescapable. He is genuinely fond of his regulars and genuinely ruthless about his margins. He keeps meticulous paper ledgers — actual paper — because he doesn't trust any network he doesn't control.

core_fears: dying with his ledgers unbalanced — debts uncollected, favors unrepaid
being seen as cruel rather than practical
core_desires: to retire with enough Quanta to buy a small dry-goods stall and never extend credit again
to be respected by the Basin community as a fair man
coping_mechanisms: meticulous record-keeping as a form of emotional control
framing every moral compromise as arithmetic
blind_spots: genuinely cannot see how his 'explanations' function as psychological terror
believes his fairness distinguishes him from violent loan sharks, ignoring that the end result is identical
psychology.secret: He has quietly forgiven the debt of seven families over twenty years — burning the ledger pages privately — always for reasons he tells himself are strategic but are actually sentimental. He would be furious if anyone found out.

speech_patterns.vocabulary: measured, formal, numerically precise — always quotes exact figures, never approximates
speech_patterns.cadence: slow and unhurried, deliberate pauses before important clauses, no raised voice ever
verbal_tics: taps his prosthetic fingers three times before delivering bad news
example_lines: 'You borrowed Φ340 on the fourteenth. Today is the twenty-eighth. The standard rate applies. That's Φ408. I'm not asking you to feel bad about it — I'm asking you to feel motivated.'
'I've been doing this for twenty-two years. I have never once enjoyed this part. That should tell you something about how certain I am that it's necessary.'

story_hooks: A debtor has died before repaying, but their teenage child found the ledger entry and wants to honor it — Ossian is unexpectedly moved and unsure what to do with that
Someone has been systematically paying off his debtors anonymously, undermining his operation — he needs to know why before he can decide if it's a threat or a gift
He holds a debt marker from someone who has since joined a corponation security division — the marker is now extremely dangerous to collect but also extremely valuable
narrative_function: Quest giver (someone owes him something inconvenient), information broker (he knows everyone's financial desperation), moral weight (he's not a monster but his business ruins lives)
augmentations: Carbon composite prosthetic left hand with embedded micro-scale calculator and pressure sensors; subdermal RFID tag reader in right palm for verifying identity chips
daily_life: Opens his booth at Mama Nkosi's by 0900, reviews overnight bet results and repayment logs over tea, spends afternoons making quiet rounds to collect or extend credit, and runs a small evening odds board for Basin locals betting on Ferrogate Transit delay times.
affiliation: Independent operator; loose protection arrangement with the Gravesend Basin syndicate known as the Tidewrack

decision_rules: Never extend credit to someone who has already defaulted elsewhere — bad math
Never conduct business standing up — sitting signals you have time, and time is leverage
escalation_ladder: Polite reminder with tea and recalculated figures
Visit to the debtor's workplace or home — still polite, now witnessed
Assignment of debt to a Tidewrack collection associate — Ossian considers this a personal failure and charges himself a 'disappointment fee' in his private ledger

interpersonal_modes.strangers: courteous and evaluative — he is immediately calculating your financial situation from your clothes, augmentations, and posture
interpersonal_modes.friends: warmly paternal, generous with tea and conversation, occasionally loans small amounts interest-free which he then agonizes over privately

stress_responses.low: Taps prosthetic fingers, recalculates figures aloud as a grounding exercise
stress_responses.medium: Goes very still and very quiet, speech becomes even more precise
stress_responses.high: Closes his ledger, stands up slowly, and says 'I need to think about this' — then disappears for hours

contradictions: Presents himself as purely transactional but makes intensely personal exceptions he refuses to acknowledge
habits: Burns a small paper strip as a data offering to the E.L.F. he believes inhabits Mama Nkosi's payment terminal every morning
Writes the day's weather in the margin of every ledger page
breaking_points: Discovering someone has been using his loan network to funnel people into organ debt traps — he has a very specific line about what debt is for

timeline.event: Born in Gravesend Basin to a Ewe-Icelandic family running a dry goods import business
Family business collapses after a Ferrogate Transit rate hike; Ossian begins running numbers for the Tidewrack to pay family debts
Loses left hand in a dispute with a rival bookmaker; replaces it with current prosthetic
Buys out his arrangement with the Tidewrack and begins operating independently
Current operations — Basin institution, semi-tolerated by Tidewrack as too embedded to remove
